# Everything this module promises, one name per line, as "<package path> <name>".
#
# The paths are the ones in publishedPackages: `core/...` and ".", the facade at
# the repository root. The facade was outside this inventory until 2026-09-12 and
# its seven names were promises nothing audited (D86).
#
# ADR 0026: every exported name here is kept until 1.0.0. This file is the
# inventory that makes adding to or withdrawing from that promise a DECISION
# rather than a side effect — see TestThePublishedNamesAreTheDeclaredOnes for
# what it covers and what it deliberately does not.
#
# A method is written "Type.Method", and an interface method the same way. The
# lines are sorted; "#" opens a comment.
